domain_selection_rule: retain the first three established high-change cases and replace the manual-only immune-checkpoint anchor with the DOI-validated 2007 Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium genome-wide association study; the original Nature article, an independent peer-reviewed contemporaneous editorial, and later peer-reviewed field histories identify the study as a landmark or field-scale starting point; the local frozen corpus supplies complete graph transitions, and three of its four frozen change-ranked indicators pass the shared absolute late-minus-pre display threshold of 0.09; no D5, OOF, citation outcome, current citation count, or future-impact variable was used
indicator_selection_rule: retain the existing field-specific four-window change ranking; for the GWAS replacement freeze the top four eligible indicators before rerendering, then apply the shared display-only late-minus-pre gate
